name: board_v0
description: YOLO11n fine-tuned on the Kaggle 'Microcontroller Detection' images (149 images). Detects ESP8266 NodeMCU boards and groups every other development board as other_board.
thresholdNote: Not calibrated: the 30-image validation set is too small to choose per-class thresholds. A conservative 0.6 plus 2-of-3-frame confirmation is used instead. Models trained with ml/component_detection/train.py get thresholds from evaluate.py.
